items.title: Fine-tune SQL Server to Aurora PostgreSQL conversions with AWS Transform and Kiro
items.summary: Introduction When customers modernize SQL Server databases with AWS Transform, most standard database objects convert automatically. A smaller set of complex objects needs human validation, and resolving them is often where modernization projects stall. In this blog post, we show how to resolve the Microsoft SQL Server objects that AWS Transform flags for human review, […]
